hero.subtitle: YOUR DAY, AT YOUR OWN PACE.

description.title: A private flight over Teotihuacán
description.paragraph: Ideal for groups, families or couples who want privacy and a flexible itinerary. Fly privately over the Teotihuacán Valley in the early morning in a compartmented Cameron Balloons basket. Executive transport from your pickup point and a reserved brunch complete the day.

steps.title: Private executive transfer
steps.description: Your bilingual guide meets you at the agreed pickup point.

steps.title: Welcome coffee
steps.description: Enjoy a coffee break while the team prepares you for boarding.

steps.title: Private flight
steps.description: Fly over the Teotihuacán Valley in a compartmented Cameron Balloons basket.

steps.title: Toast and flight certificate
steps.description: Celebrate with a traditional toast and receive your flight certificate.

steps.title: Archaeological site
steps.description: Visit the Teotihuacán archaeological site with your bilingual guide.

steps.title: Club Campestre
steps.description: Enjoy your reserved brunch before your private return transfer to Mexico City.

included: Private charter and flight services: exclusive flight, pre-flight coffee break, traditional toast, flight certificate and aviation insurance.
Premium ground transfer: private round-trip transport from Mexico City with a dedicated bilingual guide from pickup.
Culture and dining: archaeological site admission and brunch at Club Campestre, home to the Museo Gastronómico Mexicano, with lake views, a pool and equestrian activities on the grounds.
notIncluded: Guests beyond those covered by your quote.
recommendedExtras: Flight media: professional photography and video.
VIP service: a dedicated waiter, French Champagne and canapés.
Special services and culture: celebration setups and a tour of the Cuevas del Inframundo.
notes: Your itinerary is tailored to your group size and selected add-ons. Contact our sales team for a personal quote.
Flight time and route are confirmed according to weather and operating conditions.
